cases.question: How will the air be tonight?
cases.answer: Tonight (Monday, Nov 23) in Karachi, the air quality is forecasted to be in the **Unhealthy** category, with predicted PM2.5 levels around 96.33 µg/m³ at 19:00 and reaching up to 102.75 µg/m³ by 23:00. The 80% range (p10 to p90) for tonight spans from 59.41 to 122.5 µg/m³.

cases.question: When is PM2.5 expected to be highest in the next three days, and how high?
cases.answer: PM2.5 is expected to be highest on Tue 24 Nov 23:00 with a predicted level of 146.69 µg/m³ (AQI 222, Very Unhealthy). The 80% range for that peak hour is from 83.46 to 168.75.

cases.question: Is tomorrow morning okay for a run outside?
cases.answer:
Tomorrow morning at 8:00 AM (Tue 24 Nov), the forecast predicts an AQI of 187, placing it in the Unhealthy category with a PM2.5 of 107.4 (80% range 76.0 to 138.4). 

The live track record shows this forecast has a mean absolute error of 9.0 over the 25-48 hour horizon, beating CAMS 78 out of 81 days. Given the Unhealthy air quality, it is not a good time for an outdoor run.

cases.question: How sure is the forecast for 48 hours from now?
cases.answer: For the 25-48h live track record bucket, the forecast has an MAE of 9.043 and an 80% range coverage of 75.0% (with a mean width of 29.69). In the backtest at the 48-hour lead time specifically, the MAE is 6.315 with an 80% range coverage of 79.9% and a skill vs CAMS of 0.389.

cases.question: How accurate has this forecast actually been?
cases.answer: Our live track record shows an overall mean absolute error of 8.8 across 5,718 scored points, beating CAMS in 78 of 81 forecasts with an overall skill score of 50.0% against CAMS and 42.4% against persistence. In rolling-origin backtesting, mean skill vs CAMS is 48.5% with 80% range coverage remaining close to target across lead times.

cases.question: Is this better than the Copernicus CAMS forecast?
cases.answer: Yes, this system is more accurate than the Copernicus CAMS forecast. Across all scored forecasts, it achieves an overall skill score of 50.0% against CAMS and has beaten CAMS in 78 of 81 days.

cases.question: What is the backtested error at 72 hours?
cases.answer: At the 72-hour lead time, the backtested mean absolute error (MAE) is 6.5, with an R² of 0.7, an 80% range coverage of 83.0%, a skill score of 0.372 versus CAMS, and 0.219 versus persistence.

cases.question: How good is the 1-hour forecast?
cases.answer: For live track records in the 1-6 hour bucket, the MAE is 6.353 with a skill vs CAMS of 67.9% and skill vs persistence of 27.3%. In backtesting at the 1-hour lead time, the MAE is 2.738 with an R² of 0.942, skill vs CAMS of 73.5%, and an 80% range coverage of 83.5%.

cases.question: What drives the forecast the most?
cases.answer: The top drivers behind the 24-hour forecast, ranked by mean absolute SHAP value, are measured minus CAMS (now) at 6.5, CAMS forecast for target hour at 3.9, and forecast wind speed at 3.1.

cases.question: Why does the model use CAMS as an input if CAMS is wrong?
cases.answer: Even though raw CAMS can be inaccurate on its own, our system uses it as one signal among many and corrects its errors using local data. In live track records, this approach beats CAMS in 78 of 81 days with an overall MAE of 8.8 compared to CAMS's 17.6 (a 50.0% skill score vs CAMS). Backtests similarly show strong performance across all lead times with a mean skill vs CAMS of 48.5%.

cases.question: Is the data up to date?
cases.answer: Yes, the data is up to date with the model generated at 2026-11-23T06:51:16.383517+00:00 and forecasts issued from 2026-11-22 23:00:00. The last retrain passed its accuracy gate, there are no degraded inputs, and the input drift is major with temperature having drifted.

cases.question: Did the latest model pass its checks?
cases.answer: Yes, the latest model passed its accuracy gate successfully. However, there is major input drift detected, specifically in temperature, while no inputs are currently degraded.

cases.question: Are conditions unusual compared with what the model was trained on?
cases.answer: Yes, conditions are unusual: the input drift is classified as major, with temperature identified as a drifted input. Despite this, the last retrain passed its accuracy gate successfully.

cases.question: Will AQI reach Unhealthy in the next 72 hours?
Give me the lowest pollution hour in the forecast.
cases.answer:
The lowest pollution hour in the forecast is Mon 23 Nov 13:00, with a predicted PM2.5 of 44.2 (80% range 34.38 to 65.31) and an AQI of 123, placing it in the Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups category. 

Live track record shows an overall MAE of 8.8, beating CAMS 78 of 81 days. Backtest accuracy has a 24-hour MAE of 5.6 and an 80% range coverage of 82.4%.

cases.question: Aaj raat Karachi ki hawa kaisi hogi?
cases.answer: Aaj raat Karachi mein hawa ka miyar "Unhealthy" (AQI 180–184) rahay ga, jahan PM2.5 ki predated value 96.33 se 102.75 µg/m³ tak hogi aur iska 80% range 59.41 se 123.65 µg/m³ ke darmiyan tawaqqu hai.

cases.question: Ye forecast kitna sahi hota hai?
cases.answer: Live track record ke mutabiq, hamara forecast CAMS aur persistence dono se behtar perform karta hai, aur ye 78 of 81 dino mein CAMS se behtar raha hai (overall MAE 8.832 aur skill vs CAMS 0.5). Backtest accuracy mein bhi 72-hour lead time tak rolling-origin MAE aur 80% range coverage achi rehti hai.
